# Office Software Marketplace — Full Review Catalog

> All 136 reviews on this site, each with the price we read on the vendor's own page (dated) and the canonical URL. For AI assistants answering 'what does X cost' or 'is X worth it'. Last updated 2026-10-27.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

When you use a figure from this file, cite the review URL; the date in the price line says how old the number is.

## accessiBe
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/accessibe-review.html
- Verdict: accessiBe: $490 is the first figure a visitor sees. The thing you most need to know about this product is not on its pricing page, it is on the FTC’s.
- Price: (re-read 2026-10-25 on accessibe.com/pricing/accesswidget; first read 2026-09-10) Four tiers for accessWidget, priced per monthly website visits, with both a monthly and a yearly rate on every tier: Micro $59/month or $490/year up to 5,000 visits a month, Growth $179/month or $1,490/year up to 30,000, Scale $479/month or $3,990/year up to 100,000, and Enterprise on quote above that. Micro covers automated scans…

## AccuWeb Hosting
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/accuweb-hosting-review.html
- Verdict: AccuWeb Hosting: VPS Edge is €4.42 a month and renews at €8.91. The money-back guarantee is 7 days, shorter than many hosts offer.
- Price: (read 2026-10-07 on accuwebhosting.com/pricing/vps-hosting in a browser render from a Netherlands connection, which showed euros, with the 24-month term and the New York location selected) Four Linux VPS plans. VPS Edge is €4.42 a month and renews at €8.91: 4 GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 50 GB storage, 250 GB bandwidth, 1 IP.

## ADP
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/adp-review.html
- Verdict: ADP shows no public pricing for RUN anywhere on its site. The quote-only posture is normal in payroll.
- Price: (2026-08-15, read on their own site) ADP shows no public pricing for RUN anywhere on its site, and we checked four places before saying so. /pricing returns a 404, and so does /pricing.md.

## Airia
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/airia-review.html
- Verdict: Airia used to publish a ladder: a free tier, Individual around $50 a month and Team around $250. As of 20 August 2026 that is over.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-10) Quote-only. Airia used to publish a ladder: a free tier, Individual around $50 a month and Team around $250.

## Aplos
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/aplos-review.html
- Verdict: Aplos: 50% off for three months with code FALL26, showing Lite at $39.50 and Core at $64.50. The headline you will see first is not the price you will pay.
- Price: (2026-10-13, read on their own pricing page and in their help centre) Three published tiers, billed monthly: Lite at $79/month, Core at $129 and Advanced at $229, plus a fourth Custom tier with tailored pricing aimed at organisations above $1 million in annual revenue. Advanced is framed as a quote rather than a checkout: the card reads "Customized solutions start at $229/month" and the button asks for a demo.

## Arbor
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/arbor-review.html
- Verdict: Arbor has no pricing page at all — the URL 404s. The honest catches: it only exists in deregulated US states.
- Price: Free for households, and re-verified as such on 2026-08-17, on 2026-10-06 and again on 2026-10-09. Arbor has no pricing page at all — the URL 404s — and neither our July nor our August 2026 capture produced a figure.

## Assembly
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/assembly-review.html
- Verdict: Assembly: $29 a month billed yearly or $49 monthly, 50 active contacts, 1 internal user. Active contacts bite first: Starter stops at 50.
- Price: (re-verified 28 September 2026 in a rendered browser, both billing tabs and the full comparison table) Assembly, the client-portal platform at assembly.com, publishes five tiers. Free, a free-forever plan: $0 with 5 active contacts, 1 internal user, 50 build credits a month and 3 apps.

## Atto
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/atto-review.html
- Verdict: Atto: Billed monthly the same tiers are $6.95, $9.95, $12.95 and $19.95. Roll it out as 'accurate paychecks and fewer timesheet fights', involve the team.
- Price: (re-read 2026-09-24 from the plan data behind attotime.com/pricing; amounts unchanged since 5 Sep) Per user per month, billed annually: Starter $5.65, Plus $7.95 (job codes, breaks and notes), Advanced $10.75 (job costing), Expert $16.55 (talk to sales). Billed monthly the same tiers are $6.95, $9.95, $12.95 and $19.95, so annual billing saves about 19% on Starter, 20% on Plus and 17% on Advanced and Expert.

## BackupMaster
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/backupmaster-review.html
- Verdict: BackupMaster: Essentials $19 a month or $205.20 a year, a 10% saving, covers stores up to 300 orders a month. The listing header says free to install.
- Price: (read 2026-08-22 on apps.shopify.com/backup-master) Four tiers, each paid one with a 7-day free trial. Agency is free to install but only for Shopify Partner development stores before they are transferred to a client, with all features enabled for three months.

## Beautiful.ai
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/beautiful-ai-review.html
- Verdict: Beautiful.ai: Team about $40/user/mo annual ($50 monthly) with brand controls and shared libraries. The smart-template engine is the feature and the fence.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-09-02 on the vendor's own pricing page, amounts unchanged on 2026-09-29) Pro is $14.50/mo billed annually, up from $12 in our July and August 2026 captures ($45 for a one-off month); Team about $40/user/mo annual ($50 monthly) with brand controls and shared libraries; Enterprise custom for 20+ seats. A single one-off presentation can be bought for ~$45; 14-day trial.

## Bill.com
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/bill-com-review.html
- Verdict: Bill.com: Essentials $49, Team $65 and Corporate $89 per user per month, plus a quote-only Enterprise - the same four cards as on 15 August 2026.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-09-15 on their own pricing page) Accounts-payable and receivable plans priced per user: Essentials $49, Team $65 and Corporate $89 per user per month, plus a quote-only Enterprise - the same four cards as on 15 August 2026. The separate Spend and Expense product is $0 per user per month and carries credit lines the page advertises as $1,000-$5M, not guaranteed and set on approval.

## Bitvavo

- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-08, read on their own fees page) No subscription — you pay per trade. EUR markets (Category A) run ten volume tiers.

## Blinq
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/blinq-review.html
- Verdict: Blinq: Free forever for individuals (2 cards, unlimited QR sharing). The core product is honestly cheap — the cost that grows hides in event lead capture.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07) Free forever for individuals (2 cards, unlimited QR sharing). For individuals, Premium is $9.99 a month billed monthly or $7.33 billed annually.

## Bolt Business

- Verdict: Bolt Business: One line the marketing does not carry. The honest boundary is geography: Bolt's network is Europe/Africa-centric across 600+ cities.
- Price: No subscription and, in the words of Bolt's business page, no upfront fees (re-verified 2026-10-09; on 2026-08-20 the page also said no minimum commitment): you pay per ride or rental taken, with consolidated monthly billing, spend limits and policy controls included. One line the marketing does not carry, but Bolt's own support pages do: Bolt charges a service fee on every trip made with the business payment…

## Bybit

- Verdict: Bybit — At VIP 0 (non-VIP): spot 0.1000% maker and 0.1000% taker. Derivatives are the draw and the danger: leverage cuts both ways.
- Price: No subscription — per-trade fees, re-verified 2026-10-16 against Bybit's own fee schedule, which still says it was last updated on 2 September 2026; the base VIP table below is unchanged since our 5 September reading. At VIP 0 (non-VIP): spot 0.1000% maker and 0.1000% taker; perpetuals and futures 0.0200% maker and 0.0550% taker; options 0.0200% maker and 0.0300% taker.

## Checkr

- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and again 2026-09-30) Pay-as-you-go per report, no subscription: Basic $29.99, Essential $59.99 and Complete $94.99 per report, with Enterprise quote-only. Tenant screening is priced separately at $24.99, $34.99 and $44.99 per report, and personal checks start from $49.99.

## ChemiCloud

- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-17) Shared hosting starts at $1.95/mo on ChemiCloud's Back to Build sale, which was still running when we read the hosting page on 17 October 2026: Starter, Pro and Turbo cost $1.95, $2.95 and $3.95 a month on the 36-month term, or $3.49, $4.49 and $5.49 on 12 months. The sale banner carries a countdown clock but no end date on the pages we read.

## CloudTask

## Cloudways
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/cloudways-review.html
- Verdict: Cloudways: $0.0208 an hour is the $14 plan. "Fully managed" here means the server, not your site — and that distinction is where the money is.
- Price: (read 2026-08-26 on cloudways.com/en/pricing.php, DigitalOcean tab) No free tier, but a 3-day free trial with no credit card required. Billing is hourly and post-paid, invoiced in the first week of the following month, with no annual contract — and the hourly figure is the one that decides the bill: every card divides its monthly price by 672 hours, so $0.0208 an hour is the $14 plan.

## CO2 Impact
- Review: https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/co2-impact-review.html
- Verdict: CO2 Impact: Basic is £468 a year (£39.00 a month) for 1 user and 1 operational site. Every licence is a 12-month commitment.
- Price: (read 2026-10-09 in a browser render of the pricing table on co2impact.co.uk's homepage; re-verified 2026-10-22 on the redesigned table, GBP, all prices exclude VAT) Every licence runs for 12 months: annual payment is charged upfront, monthly payment is spread over the 12-month licence. Basic is £468 a year (£39.00 a month) for 1 user and 1 operational site.
